summary: Mid-sized legal analytics vendor evaluating Redwood Private for large-scale RAG. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking at scale (tens of millions of docs), strict retention and immutable audit logging, VPC/on-prem deployment. Performance targets tight for UI search flows.
notes:
Account context: Luminara builds a compliance + discovery layer for law firms and corporate legal teams. They process consolidated discovery sets (custodial data + 3rd-party docs).

Key technical requirements (from SE calls):
- Indexing scale: target 50M-120M pages (roughly 25-60M docs after chunking). Need guidance on sharding/partitioning and incremental indexing costs.
- Embedding store: prefer vector store in customer VPC or on-prem (no external vector hosting). Looking for recommendations re: quantized embeddings and cold-start cost.
- Reranking: two-stage retrieval (FAISS/approximate ANN) + learned transformer reranker for precision in top-10. Latency budget: 120-200ms p95 for single-query in UI; 20k qps batch search for bulk e-discovery jobs is also required.
- Cost targets: want <$0.03 per interactive query (embeddings + rerank combined) at steady state, and detailed cost model for peak nightly indexing runs.
- Security/compliance: must support SSO (SAML), KMS-managed keys, immutable audit logging retained 7+ years, per-cust data residency for EU clients. Legal hold functionality must prevent deletions while still supporting retention policies.
- Ops: they want fine-grained observability: per-route token & latency breakdown, tracing to rung-level, and automated alerts for embedding drift/regression.

Quotes/voice notes: "We cannot push vectors outside our VPC for regulated customers — that's non-negotiable." — Head of Platform (call 2026-03-02).

POC plan: Redwood to ingest 50M pages (subset: 10M EU) into Private deployment inside Luminara VPC; run A/B reranking vs current Solr+learning-to-rank pipeline; measure p95 latencies, cost per query, and precision@10 on curated test set.

Operational notes from SE (Omar): need to test KV cache effectiveness for long chat sessions and prefix cache for common queries. Also evaluate quantized model variants for reranker to reduce GPU cost.

Procurement notes: procurement/finance engaged; forecasted ARR in range $250k-$750k; legal wants standard data processing addendum + proof of SOC2.

Next comms: schedule POC kickoff (2-3 weeks out), share ingestion manifest and a sample security runbook. Need Redwood security FAQ and EU data residency proof by next week.
notes_short: Evaluation: large-scale embeddings + rerank POC in VPC. Key blockers: SAML timeline, EU residency proof, budget. POC: 50M pages, measure latency & cost per query.
